note: Zoom on the pie counter of the big-numbers room (cartoon style): fractions. Feminine la moitié (a red apple cut in half) on the left of the divider; masculine on the right: le quart (seated man holding a pie with a quarter missing), le tiers (layered cake with a third cut out), le cinquième (pie in five slices, one lifted out on a server). The blank card on the wall is the sign.
